title: ID0455716-DC/Si-D/DK- [MP / R3 170001644] Black screen
description:
Reported behavior/issue :
MCZnP3
The customer reports that the screen is black, with some light showing in the bottom.
We have checked 24VDC supply, Display cable and done a onsite reboot.
Nothing changes.
No error messages in SCB.
Solution: asked RC/FST to replace HMI.
